notes.title: Ven VR Adventure - PATCH 1.2 coming with the Steam version!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community! Ven VR Adventure launches on Steam this week! We have the list of changes coming with the new patch. The update 1.2 will be already implemented in the Steam version on the release day, January 28th, so you will be playing an improved game at the start![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/6c5af4fde95e552286f0f55eb533ec8215ed29c0.png[/img]

Here is what we’ve been cooking for you the last couple of weeks:

[list]
[*] Places, where players had difficulty during gameplay because Ven was too far from them, were redesigned in every location in the game. It brings a lot of improvement to the gameplay but the base experience stays the same :) 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added difficulty levels to the game - the player can change them during profile creation as well as during gameplay.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Difficulty levels do not affect level design but determine: number of checkpoints, lives for Ven at the start as well as runes and crates demanded to gain another life.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Snap Turn Option - default on (improves the mechanics of looking around).
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added hints in a form of new pictures in the tablet - a lot of players were not using special attack or they had problems with some game mechanics.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added an indicator of collected runes on the right-hand watch.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed problem with frogs - now they will always kill the player with one strike.
[/list]
[list]
[*] A huge number of fixes and tweaks for the tutorial, menu and lobby.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Various bug fixes, optimization and stability improvements.
[/list]

Note: One the same day the update will be also available for Oculus Rift and Viveport users ;) 

Yours,
Monologic Games

notes.title: NAME YOUR ROBOT ENEMY - create Ven VR Adventure with us! [Community Contest]
notes.content:
[b]Woohoo! We’re about to start the first community contest for Ven VR Adventure! Do you like robots? Would like to be involved in the creative process of our game? Here is a perfect chance to have some fun and help us![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/d6f62f3d724d2a108f7283001709469395dc6046.jpg[/img]

“Name Your Robot Enemy” is the community contest in which you simply help us invent names for the robots that will be encountered by Ven and the player character throughout the game.

Each Friday on our Twitter account we will be posting one of the 8 concept arts of robots from Ven VR Adventure. [b]Your task is to just give us your idea of a name for each one of them![/b] We will choose the best ones and put them in the game! 

[h3]The winner for each robot will get the place in the credits of our game![/h3]

Please remember that you can only win once :) 

Winners of the contest will be revealed a few weeks before the release of Ven VR Adventure!

Yours,
Monologic Games

notes.title: Monthly Venlog #1 - February
notes.content:
[b]Today we are giving you the first Monthly Venlog which is a summary of the last month of our work on Ven VR Adventure. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/1556c43ba874813edce27a68cef1800b9b035847.jpg[/img]

It is just the beginning of the adventure with Ven and we already received such an amazing response from you guys. [b]We would like to say a huge THANK YOU for all of your kind comments, positive reception and adding our game to wishlists![/b] 

We are very grateful and highly motivated for the upcoming months to deliver a high-quality VR platformer for you! As a reminder, the development of Ven VR Adventure began in March 2019. Our aim for the release is Q2 2020. 

[b]During February we were working on finalizing our work on about half of all locations that will be present in the game. Also, we completely redesigned the system of “supporting” Ven by the player - we do hope you’ll love it! [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]TEASER TRAILER[/b] - this month we also managed to show you the first short teaser of our game which you can watch below and see a glimpse of gameplay as well:
[/list]
[previewyoutube=4wRiyS-PU1w;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]LOOKING AT THE PLAYER[/b] - another cool thing that we presented to the public was the video showing how Ven is looking at the player in the game. We plan to implement lots of cool animations and details to let you interact with our little hero and strengthen your bond with him. 
[/list]
[previewyoutube=OpFiVwIt3bI;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]FIGHTING ANIMATIONS[/b] - the last piece that we shared with you is the video presenting fighting skills of Ven. As you can see, he is using dual blades and is able to perform many cool attacks. It is just a glimpse but we cannot wait to show you more in the future!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=VrFAFl-LjF0;full][/previewyoutube]

The response from the gaming media was also very kind. We would like to thank those who were helping us spreading the word about Ven! Check those cool articles below:
